name: @gakonst/cdj-usb
description: Differential CDJ-3000 media synchronizer and safe Linux USB mass-storage appliance controller
author: Georgios Konstantopoulos

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json README.md deploy && cargo +nightly fmt --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml --all
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json README.md deploy && cargo +nightly fmt --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
scripts.lint: oxlint src scripts && cargo clippy --manifest-path ../../rust/Cargo.toml -p djbooth-rs --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings
